included.title: Routing, switching and security

items.title: Yours to keep

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Egypt?
items.a: Yes. Work that can be delivered online is done remotely for clients anywhere in the world. Work that needs us on site depends on where you are, so tell us your location and we will confirm how we can help.

items.q: How quickly will you reply to my request?
items.a: We reply to every new request within one week, with questions or a quote.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope. After a short discovery conversation we send a written quote with what is included, the timeline and the price.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. A small project can take a few weeks, and larger or on-site work takes longer. You get a timeline in the quote.

items.q: Do you support what you build after delivery?
items.a: Yes. We offer support and maintenance after handover, and we agree the terms in the quote.

items.q: Will I own my website and accounts?
items.a: Domains, hosting and cloud accounts are set up in your name, and we hand over documentation with the project.

pages.aboutH1: One team for the technology your business runs on
pages.aboutDescription: Echo Tech designs, builds and supports business technology: networks, CCTV, websites, apps, internal systems and automation. One team instead of five suppliers.
pages.aboutLead: Echo Tech designs, builds and supports business technology: networks and cameras, websites and apps, internal systems and automation.
story: Most businesses end up with a different supplier for the network, the cameras, the website and the internal tools. When something breaks, each one points at another.

At Echo Tech the same team handles all of it, so the parts work together and you have one place to call. Our first client, Joy Zone in Alexandria, is the example: we built its website, its network, its CCTV system and its internal CRM.
We explain things in plain language, quote before we start, and set up your domain, hosting and accounts in your name.
